rows.grounds: fused form of nārī (woman) and athavā (or)
a person of non-male-non-female sex or impotent person
compound of mokṣa (liberation) and adhikārin (one entitled); surface form as given

items.question: Which categories of persons are entitled to pursue liberation regardless of gender or social status?
premises: A man is included among those eligible.
A woman or a neuter person is included among those eligible.
All such persons are entitled to liberation.
items.inference: Eligibility for liberation is universal across gender categories, encompassing men, women, and neuter persons alike.
uncertainties: The surface form 'mokṣādhikāriṇaiḥ' is non-standard for the expected nominative plural; it is analyzed functionally as nominative plural.
items.plain_english: Whether a man, a woman, or a neuter person, all are entitled to liberation.
